name: Tumerok Fort (9.7S, 63.3W)
title: 9.7S, 63.3W - Tumerok Fort
summary: A huge Tumerok fort with loads of Augmented Tumeroks (acpedia, Points of Interest Map no. 32), the largest fortification in this batch. It is about 200 x 220 m of flat-roofed black halls with stake palisades and eight 31 m spire towers on a flat valley floor (z 36). Shards of the Abyssal Totem standing stones block several entrances, and the Tumerok Dungeon portal is in the inner courtyard.

shots.standingOrder: Race east 4 m off the fort's long south wall at head height between its two spire towers, wall on the left; never closer than 3 m to the stone.
shots.notes: FPV proximity: the drone races east at 10.5 m/s, 2.5 m above the ground and 4 m off the long south wall of the huge Tumerok fort (flat-roofed black halls with stake palisades), between its two corner spire towers. The south-east tower grows ahead-left (subject ndc up to -0.25, 0.66). The late-afternoon sun lights the wall from behind-right. The wall is a backdrop rather than a facade pan: it is fast, close and tracks a tower ahead. shots.standingOrder: Hang 250 m south-west and 85 m above the huge Tumerok fort with the sun behind, drifting 10 degrees and easing 8 percent closer over its eight spire towers and walls.
shots.notes: Establishing: the lens hangs 250 m south-west of the fort and 87 m up with the sun behind it. It drifts 10 deg and eases 8% closer over the 200 x 220 m fortification: eight spire towers, rows of halls, courtyards and the standing stones that block its entrances. It is the scale shot of the batch's biggest Tumerok fort.
